body:
🟡🐛 **Consider · bug: The rail badge still counts copies that were deleted**

`libraryBadgeCount` (`ready-copies.ts:74`) counts every unannounced entry in the store. The Library page, though, only counts copies that are still in `videos` (`library-page.tsx:62`). Say a copy finishes and the user deletes it before opening the Library, for example from its detail page through another path. The rail then shows "1 new copy ready", and the Library page shows no chip and no outlined card for it. The entry also stays in the store until the app relaunches, because nothing calls `markCopySeen` for a deleted asset. One fix: call `markCopySeen(assetId)` from the Library's delete path. Another: filter the badge count by the assets that still exist.

🟡🐛 **Consider · bug: "Drag to upload" can get keyboard focus but does nothing when pressed**

The old drag chip had `tabIndex={-1}`. It now renders through `StatusCardButton` as a real `<button>` with no `onClick`. Keyboard users can Tab to it, and Enter or Space does nothing, because the only thing it does is a mouse drag. One option: keep it out of the tab order. Another: give it a keyboard fallback, such as revealing the file.

🟡🧪 **Consider · tests: The verify test's name still says the old "Ready to share" card**

The comment on line 5 and the locators on lines 24–26 now look for the "Your export is ready" card. The test is still called `"export: editor to the Ready to share card"`, which names a card that no longer exists.

🟡🧹 **Consider · cleanup: Spanish drag label switched from infinitive to imperative**

The removed `readyDragLabel` read "Arrastrar {name} fuera de Kaipu". The new `backgroundCopy.readyDragLabel` reads "Arrastra {name} fuera de Kaipu". The other action labels in this block use the infinitive: "Abrir {name} en tu Biblioteca" and "Arrastrar para subir". If the change wasn't intended, keep "Arrastrar" so the aria-labels match.

🟡📝 **Consider · docs: Effort "Small" is not on the table's scale**

Every other row in the Effort column uses Low / Medium / High / Large (or Low–Medium, Varies, —). The new row says "Small". Use "Low" to stay on the same scale.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

This does not hold for the in-app delete paths: opening a copy's detail page calls `markCopySeen` (now in `useExportBadge`, `shell/sidebar.tsx:119`, after #467 moved the badge to the Export rail item), and a delete from the Library grid happens with the Library open, where `announceReadyCopies` has already taken the copy out of the count. Only a file removed outside Kaipu can leave a stale count, and that clears on the next visit to Export or the Library; the leftover store entry is in memory and harmless, since the Library filters by `videos`.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**
